comments: Registered as one bank: the bowl and legs share one scale and one baseline (bottom of the legs); the source pivot x is the bowl centre in each crop, not the crop centre, because a leaning flame widens its crop.
The tallest flame (lit-0) sets the shared scale so that no frame is clipped; the stage stamps the bottom-centre at the tile foot.

The shared 75-ink palette has no saturated orange: the flame cores snap to its gold and the outer flame to its red, so lit frames measure below the 0.90 colour-agreement diagnostic against the unquantized sample.
geometry: Collision is one tile and belongs to the rules; art never sets a hitbox. The stage stamps the frame bottom-centre at the tile centre x and one half tile below the tile centre y (the tile foot).
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: the unlit ash bowl is out-0; the four flame shapes (tall, lean left, short and fat, lean right) are lit-0..3; the dying flame (bent tip), the small flame with sparks and the two embers with a smoke curl are gutter-0..2.

size_basis: native canvas 14x20, anchor bottom-centre (7,20); stage 384x224 at 16 px per tile; a knight is 16x16; a brazier is a little shorter than 1.3 knights.
timing: out 12 ticks; lit 4x4 ticks; gutter 3x4 ticks (30 Hz). Art never sets a hitbox (collision is one tile).
